resources.string: The selected provider will receive the current song, artist, album and duration and query Apple for animated artwork. Enable the source and network settings in the provider first. This test uses the verified device layout and resets after SystemUI restarts.

Provider discovery, read-only video and first-frame preview

Use the local provider for fixed video or the AM provider for real song matching. Configure the source and authorize Bridge, then select the matching test mode. Only one surface plays, with the large cover preferred. Native flip effects keep the static cover. Enable again after restarting SystemUI. Persistent settings and C17 dual-slot support remain unfinished.
Test enable request sent. Check the lockscreen card or large cover and logs.
Keep the screen on while the motion cover plays

Keeps the screen on only while a motion cover is actually playing on the large cover. Pausing, pressing the power button to go to sleep or AOD, unlocking, or returning to the small card releases it, and the normal screen timeout applies again. Independent of “Keep screen on while lyrics are shown”: the screen stays on while either applies. Changes apply to a running test immediately.
